# Invoke actions in Terraform Developer Portal

Terraform Developer Portal lets application developers invoke Terraform actions on their applications and installed add-ons to run predefined maintenance tasks, such as invalidating a cache or restarting a virtual machine, and to review each action's invocation history.

@include "beta/tdp.mdx"

Platform engineers can define Terraform actions in the no-code modules that back their templates and add-on definitions. Each provider defines its own actions for maintenance workflows. For example, a provider action can shut down a virtual machine. Terraform Developer Portal makes actions from the module available to application developers.

Refer to the [action block reference](/terraform/language/block/action) for information on how to define actions in Terraform configuration.

## Prerequisites

To trigger a Terraform action in a Terraform Developer Portal application or add-on, you must define an action in the no-code module used to deploy them.

## Invoke an action

To invoke an action defined in the no-code module for an application or an add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to invoke the action.
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the action or add-on action that you want to invoke.
1. Optionally, if you are invoking an action on an installed add-on, click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel, then click the name of the add-on with the action you want to invoke.
1. Click **Actions** in the left navigation panel.
1. Click the name of the action you want to invoke.
1. Click the **Invoke** button.
1. In the **Select a run type** dropdown, choose **Plan and apply**, then click **Invoke**.

Terraform Developer Portal redirects you to the Terraform run in the workspace backing your application or add-on. After HCP Terraform completes the plan operation, it automatically applies it to invoke the action and displays the result.

## View action invocation history

To view an action's run history for an application or add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to review the action history.
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the action or add-on action that you want to review.
1. Optionally, to review the invocation history for an installed add-on, click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel, then click the name of the add-on with the action history you want to review.
1. Click **Actions** in the left navigation panel.
1. In the action overview, Terraform Developer Portal displays the details for the latest invocation. To view the entire invocation history for the action, click **View invocation history on workspace**.
